tests.name: gateway alive after the greeting-rung change
staging reports env=staging and the deployed commit

tests.reason: This VTID only changes what two greeting rungs TELL the model; there is no new route, flag or schema to probe. The behaviour is pinned by vtid-04724-resume-directive-language.test.ts (mutation-verified both halves), the changed rung's own vtid-04575-resume-thread-rung.test.ts, and the re-recorded golden/payload-identity snapshots — all in this suite. A read-only staging suite cannot speak to the voice model, and the real signal is the post-deploy oasis_events query in outputs/telemetry-ru-sessions.txt showing resume_thread sessions no longer answering in German.
